#: Validation and export safety for manual, body-local capsule editing.
colliderEditor.changes: capsule changes must contain only p1, p2 and radius
colliderEditor.lastCapsule: keep at least one capsule on %(bone)s: removing an entire collision body is not supported
colliderEditor.radius: capsule radius must be a finite, nonnegative number
colliderEditor.unsupported: the %(kind)s shape on %(bone)s contains unsupported geometry and cannot be edited safely
colliderEditor.vector: %(field)s must contain exactly three finite numbers
